description: This file defines a React component 'PermissionGroup' used for managing and rendering permission groups in the Mattermost admin console, including permission toggling, scope checking, and nested permission rendering.

classes.name: PermissionGroup
classes.description: A React component for displaying and managing permission groups with nested permissions, supporting toggling, scope filtering, and inheritance.

methods.name: getRecursivePermissions
methods.description: Recursively collects all permission strings from a nested permissions structure.

methods.name: toggleExpanded
methods.description: Toggles the expanded/collapsed state of the permission group.

methods.name: toggleSelectRow
methods.description: Handles selection of individual permission rows.

methods.name: toggleSelectSubGroup
methods.description: Handles selection of subgroups within the permission group.

methods.name: toggleSelectGroup
methods.description: Toggles the selection state of the entire permission group, updating permissions accordingly.

methods.name: isInScope
methods.description: Checks if a permission is within the current scope (channel or team).

methods.name: renderPermission
methods.description: Renders a permission row if within scope.

methods.name: fromParent
methods.description: Checks if a permission is inherited from the parent role.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Determines the checkbox status ('checked', 'intermediate', or '') for a set of permissions.

methods.name: hasPermissionsOnScope
methods.description: Checks if any permissions are within the current scope.

methods.name: allPermissionsFromParent
methods.description: Checks if all permissions are inherited from the parent role.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Main render method for the component, displaying permission rows and groups.
